resources.string: Stores a lossless PNG as Base64 text, beginning with data:image/png;base64,. Open this text file again to recover the image. Base64 is larger than the PNG it contains.
Writes plain text using light and dark characters. View it in a monospaced font. This is a visual rendition; it cannot be reopened as the original image.
The Base64 text does not contain a supported image.
